name: tmux-agent-orchestrator
title: Tmux Agent Orchestrator
summary: Give your primary agent a clear way to supervise another agent running in tmux—from the first assignment to a verified result.
useWhen: An agent is working in a tmux pane and you want help checking progress, answering its questions, directing its next steps, or preparing a session for restoration.
example: Use tmux-agent-orchestrator to find the agent working on this project, check its progress, and supervise it until the task is complete. Verify the result before reporting back.
note: Bring your own installed agent. No vendor-specific API is required. Restoring a conversation depends on the agent’s own resume support; a tmux snapshot alone cannot restore process memory.
